connect.title: Connect the logger
connect.sub: Plug it into this laptop with a USB-C cable. It appears below.
connect.ports_note: checked every 2 s · ports stay closed
connect.caution: Not measured yet: opening the port may restart the device, so connect it for the first time while it is not recording.
connect.measured_safe: This board did not restart when opened with {method} (checked {date}).
connect.measured_rule: This board restarts when the port opens. Connect first, then start recording.
connect.restarted: The device restarted when the port was opened.
connect.noreply: No reply. Check that no other program has the port open and that the firmware is flashed.
connect.open_failed: The port could not be opened ({err}). Check that no other program (pio device monitor, ...) has it open.
connect.format: This app does not support this firmware's record format.
connect.noport: No port appears. Check that the USB-C cable carries data.
connect.download: The device started in its flashing mode. Press its RST button.
connect.connecting: Connecting · watching for 3 s whether opening the port restarted the device
connect.lost: The device was disconnected. Plug it back in and press Enter.
connect.lost_auto: The device was disconnected. It reconnects by itself when plugged back in.
fs.error: The storage cannot be opened. Follow firmware/README.md.
dev.disconnect_ask: This board restarts when the port closes. Disconnecting while it records cuts the recording. Disconnect anyway?
dev.basic: This firmware does not send positions while recording. Positions appear on the map after the recording is pulled.
dev.live_note: This firmware sends positions while recording. Press I to go back to the map.
dev.export_mode: Wi-Fi export is on. Hold the button for more than 6 s to turn it off.
tile.mode_hint: short press while idle, screen on, to change
test.title: Test recording
test.intro: Press T to start a test recording. Follow five steps with the device button; the app then pulls the recording and checks it.
test.s1: Hold the button for 2.5 s, then let go.
test.s1_hint: Holding it for more than 6 s turns on Wi-Fi export.
test.s4: Hold the button for 2.5 s again, then let go.
test.export_on: Wi-Fi export is on. Hold the button for more than 6 s to turn it off.
test.full: Storage is full, so recording cannot start. Delete exported recordings.
test.hint: Holding it for more than 6 s while idle turns on Wi-Fi export.
test.before_note: This recording began before the laptop was connected.
test.interrupted: The connection was lost, so the test stopped.
test.restarted: The device restarted during the test.

check.meta: {n} done · the rest after the recording
check.later_list: GNSS receiver, position, row spacing, file integrity, screen
check.button_wait: appears when you press the button
tools.conn_sub: finds out whether opening or closing the port restarts the device
tools.cal_sub: matches the reading to your multimeter
result.ok: Recording, storage and transfer all work
result.same: SHA-256 matches the device copy · using the file on this laptop
result.count_wait: {n} checks · {p} passed · {i} for information · {f} failed · {w} to answer
res.file.title: File intact
res.file.bad: The SHA-256 differs from the device · CRC {ok}/{total}. Pull it again. The failed copy is kept as {bad}.
res.ended.title: Ended normally
res.ended.recovered: RECOVERED_ON_BOOT · a restart cut the session and the next boot closed it
res.ended.open: No end record. The session is not closed on the device yet.
end.LOW_BATTERY: the device stopped because the battery was low
end.STORAGE_FULL: the device stopped because the storage was full
end.FS_ERROR: the device stopped because of a storage error
res.spacing.title: Row spacing
res.spacing.filler: {n} rows · every 1.5 s (receiver has no time yet; common indoors)
res.spacing.short: rows: {n} · fewer than 20. Record for more than 30 s.
res.spacing.step: {n} rows · largest step {max} s (at {at} s). A step over 1.6 s means rows are missing.
res.gnss.title: GNSS receiver
res.gnss.nodata: No data arrives from the receiver. Check that the TEL0157 switch is on UART, D/T goes to D11 (IO16), C/R to D10 (IO17), and 3V3 and GND are connected. If it still fails, the baud rate may differ (firmware WFG_GNSS_BAUD 9600, next try 115200).
res.gnss.cksum: Only corrupted sentences arrived. A wire may be loose or noisy. Check the connections again.
res.position.title: Position
res.position.fix: fix rows: {n} · satellites: up to {sats} · best HDOP {hdop}
res.position.none: no fix · normal indoors. Test again outside to record positions.
res.button.title: Button
res.button.none: No button mark. Step 2 was skipped, or the button (IO27) does not respond.
res.battery.title: Battery
res.battery.none: No battery value. Check the cell's PH2.0 connection.
res.storage.title: Storage
res.storage.low: Storage is almost full ({mb} MB). Delete exported recordings (usb_export.py).
res.screen.title: Screen
res.screen.ask: Did the device screen show REC?
res.screen.unseen: Check that BLK goes to D7 (IO13) and the other SPI pins follow the assembly guide.
res.restart.title: Restart on port open
res.restart.yes: yes · connect first, then start recording
res.clock.title: Clock
res.clock.later: synchronised once there is a fix
screen.ask: Did the device screen show REC?

cc.title: Connection check
cc.sub: Finds out whether opening or closing the port, or unplugging the cable, restarts the device. It takes 2 to 6 minutes.
cc.battery_note: On USB the voltage can look normal with no cell fitted. Without a cell the cable case is skipped.
cc.start_rec: Hold the button for 2.5 s, then let go, to start a recording.
cc.stop_rec: Hold the button for 2.5 s, then let go, to stop the recording.
cc.unplug: Unplug the cable, wait 3 s, and plug it back in.
cc.replug: Now plug the cable back in.
cc.pull: Checking the recordings made during the check
cc.case.B: B · DTR and RTS low before open
cc.wait.resume_counter: Waiting {s} s so the device resets its restart counter
cc.done: Saved. From now on the app opens with {method}.
cc.done_rule: Every way of opening restarts the board. Connect first, then start recording.
cc.auto_yes: After an unplug, the app reconnects by itself.
cc.auto_no: After an unplug, press Enter to reconnect.
cc.method.lines_low: DTR and RTS low before open
wifi.title: Pull over Wi-Fi
wifi.s1: While the device is idle, hold its button for more than 6 s to turn on Wi-Fi export.
wifi.s2: Join the WFG-LOGGER- network shown on the device screen from this Mac yourself. The password is on the device screen too.
wifi.s3: Once joined, the recordings appear below.
wifi.note: The app never changes network settings. Rejoin your usual Wi-Fi afterwards. The device turns export off after 10 minutes without a client.
cal.title: Battery calibration
cal.s1: Measure the cell at its plug pins with the multimeter.
cal.s2: Type the value in mV and send it. USB charging lifts the voltage, so read the meter and type the value at the same moment.
cal.range: The device accepts 3000 to 4300 mV and a correction between 0.800 and 1.200.
cal.bad_input: Type the measured value in mV as a number, for example 4100.

live.activity.start: Hold the device button 2.5 s and release to start. I opens device controls.
